taxonomy-ai-data-ai3-5.rule: Canonical static owner executes DATA-AI1-5 verifier chain, architecture guard, dependency install, and production build once per relevant SHA. Existing phase workflows preserve their workflow/job names, manual fallback verification, and push-only deployed runtime probes.

taxonomy-ai-prelaunch.rule: DATA-AI25 exclusively owns its full operational-readiness verifier. PRELAUNCH-01 owns pre-launch acceptance and hosted-runner syntax only; it preserves the post-launch evidence boundary through its own acceptance contract without directly re-executing the DATA-AI25 verifier.

current-main-cross-cutting.rule: Current Main remains the project-wide final gate. For proven canonical DATA-AI1-5, DATA-AI25, and PRELAUNCH-01 contracts it reuses exact-head, exact-event successful canonical workflow results; if no matching canonical run exists or Actions lookup is unavailable, it executes the original verifier locally. A discovered canonical non-success fails closed.
